best.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Low confidence: 0.6-0.9 m, 229 kJ, 10 s period, consistent 66/100, and wind is the main risk.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches; worth keeping on the radar because Surfline is showing it above Poor while most other local spots are Poor..  Watch: wind is over 30 km/h; wind fit is poor or too strong; 10-13s at high tide can get fat and slow in the sheltered bay; gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy; SwellMap rating 3/10 Poor — caution.
best.shortExplanation: Cantinho da Baia is worth a quick check for after work (16:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide helps a bit, but the bay still needs enough push.
